name: Steamed Pork Bao Bun (Worlds of Marvel)
whyItWorks: Cloud-soft steamed white-flour lotus bun with tender braised pork digests easily once you pull out any pickled vegetables or jalapeno slices.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Remove any pickled daikon/cucumber, raw scallions, or chili garnish from inside the bun and enjoy the pillowy steamed bao and tender pork.
watchOuts: Pickled vegetable garnish and raw scallions
